title: Go: Maps
description: Create, manipulate, and iterate over maps in Go.

steps.title: Make a Map
steps.description: Use `make` to create a map `ages map[string]int`, add entries `"Alice": 30` and `"Bob": 25`, then print it.

verification.failureMessage: Create a map with make, add Alice=30 and Bob=25, then print.

steps.title: Map Literal
steps.description: Create a map literal `scores := map[string]int{"Math": 90, "Science": 85}` and print it.
hints: Commas are needed after each entry, even the last one.

verification.failureMessage: Create a map literal with Math=90 and Science=85 and print it.

steps.title: Get, Set, Delete
steps.description: Create a map `capitals := map[string]string{"JP": "Tokyo"}`, add `"FR": "Paris"`, delete `"JP"`, and print the map.

verification.failureMessage: Add FR=Paris, delete JP, and print the result.

steps.title: Check Key Existence
steps.description: Create a map `m := map[string]int{"a": 1}` and check if key `"b"` exists using the comma-ok idiom, printing the result.
hints: `ok` is `true` if the key exists, `false` otherwise.
Print `ok` or a message like `"Key b not found"`.

verification.failureMessage: Check if key 'b' exists and print that it doesn't.

steps.title: Iterate with Range
steps.description: Create a map `colors := map[string]string{"R": "Red", "G": "Green", "B": "Blue"}` and iterate over it with `for range`, printing each key and value.
hints: `for k, v := range colors { fmt.Println(k, v) }`
Map iteration order is not guaranteed in Go.

verification.failureMessage: Print all key-value pairs from the colors map.
